newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Death toll in Vietnam Red River disaster rises.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Vietnam Red River disaster rises.

text.p: The death toll in a ferry accident earlier this week on the Red River near Hanoi has risen to 21, police said on Friday.
A district police official said by phone that the bodies of all but five of those believed missing had been found. All were women.
The crowded ferry, carrying villagers from a local market, capsized close to a main Hanoi bridge on Monday night after colliding with barges in a narrow river channel.
Survivors said the barge crew had failed to respond to shouted warnings of the impending disaster. On Wednesday the wreckage of the ferry was dragged from the river by crane.
An investigation into the accident, the worst on Vietnam's Red River in three years, is under way.
